title: Moxi text laboratory
scenario: F01: real HarfBuzz glyphs and retained FreeType outlines, rendered as an executable replay with explicit missing coverage.
backend: HarfBuzz 14.5.0 / FreeType / Fontconfig; SVG outlines in Chromium
fixture: Arial, Arial Unicode MS, Hiragino Sans resolved by host Fontconfig; five executable states plus retained snapshot
reproduce: Run pixi run text-laboratory; serve dist/text-laboratory with python3 -m http.server; open index.html at 1280 x 800 CSS pixels, device scale 2; visit #mixed, #wrap, #fallback, #selection, #edit, #mixed. Browser navigation selects precomputed executable states; it does not execute text editing.

slides.caption: Mixed scripts and explicit missing coverage
slides.expected: Three lines; revision 4; one build; two missing emoji clusters on this host.

slides.caption: Resize the paragraph constraint
slides.action: Open #wrap, the executable state with a 330-unit constraint.
slides.expected: Five lines; two builds; composed fallback units stay together.

slides.caption: Change fallback order
slides.expected: Revision 5 and three builds; CJK outlines change.

slides.caption: Selection reuses the cached paragraph
slides.expected: 38 selection rectangles, source offset 42, three builds and one cache hit.

slides.caption: Delete one composed unit
slides.expected: The whole e + acute unit disappears; cursor 3; four builds and one cache hit.

slides.caption: Revisit the retained original snapshot
slides.action: Return to #mixed after viewing the edited state. The executable also writes retained.svg after all edits.
slides.expected: The original paragraph remains intact; retained.svg is byte-identical to mixed.svg. This is snapshot retention, not an editor undo interaction.
